Interpolates the songs "Pink Cookies In a Plastic Bag Getting Crushed By Buildings" by LL COOL J and "My Humps" by Black Eyed Peas. It is on streaming, but only in some territories (also excluding the US) for some reason.

title: Ant Clemons - Pootie Tang [V1]
status_source_term: OG File | OG File | CD Quality
description: Solo Ant Clemons version. According to xtcy, the file was in a folder of Jeremih and Ant Clemons tracks. On February 10th, 2018, Legion on Instagram posted a snippet along with what looks to be a scrapped music video. According to Ant Clemons in a Rolling Stone article, "the first day [Bongo ByTheWay and I] met we did 11 records... There’s a couch in the studio, so if I outwork Bongo and he falls asleep, I can sleep on his couch.'". The article later states "Bongo stayed awake for long enough to be impressed with Clemons’ output. He took Clemons to meet Jeremih; West called on Jeremih to come to Wyoming to participate in the sessions for Ye, Jeremih played West a demo with Clemons titled 'All Mine'. and West pounced on it". According to Ant Clemons, the song was shown to Ye one week before the album's release. ROBOTSCOTT's release credit likely comes out of courtesy for him being a large contributor to this version of the song and shaping the vision, as none of this production is on release and the stems do not mention him at all.

description:
After taking a break from music in early 2021 due to his divorce with Kim Kardashian, Kanye went to work at the Pio Pico studio in LA, owned by frequent collaborators Nick Knight and Vanessa Beecroft, with an entirely new vision for the album. While the name remained the same, the sound shifted to be more experimental and less soulful. Working with producers such as E.VAX, Dem Jointz, and Digital Nas, Kanye went through hundreds of beats, laying down vocals and trying to come up with ideas for songs. This era would continue until Kanye decided to finalize the album, shifting to the more minimalistic release sound.

(03/07/2021) (CyHi confirms that Kanye has resumed work on the album)
(07/09/2021) (Malik Yusef posts about a change in sound direction for Donda)

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids ‘Slate’ brings together understated neutral tones with a modern, minimalist design. No-tie elastic laces secure the form-fitting Primeknit upper, composed of light grey yarns and accented with a distinctive center stitch down the vamp. A streak of black on the lateral side displays ‘SPLY-350’ branding. The sock-like build is mounted on a full-length Boost midsole, wrapped in a semi-translucent TPU cage and supported by a grippy rubber outsole.
